status: INCONCLUSIVE for fresh per-phase timings; historical envelope measured
method: Median of ms per complete same-stream interval between successive Q6_K LM-head ends. Require 48 one-row Q8 KV visits and 24 alternating QKV+FFN chains with exact control-input and rank grid shapes. Input-local span is the sum of all 48 input durations and both neighboring same-stream kernel gaps. Gaps are traced, not adjusted for any intervening DMA, and are not launch overhead. Rank/GPU output times are matched to the control chain by adjacency, not global GEMV statistics.

upper_bound.strict_scope: Conditional attribution for the message/input path with neighbors otherwise unchanged, not a proven ceiling on secondary system effects or fresh Tideglass performance. Existing kernels also do non-hoistable current RMS; realistic savings must subtract grouped preparation, current RMS scheduling and consumption overhead. Rank/output are excluded.

conversions.formula: If saving d ms out of baseline T=1000/r, new rate=1000/(T-d). Rounded examples use the upper end 0.325002 ms. Separate Bartowski Q4_0 untraced historical baselines; no candidate was run.
